high: bank_design accepts unnecessary concrete on non-severe protected sections. Because each case receives the minimum safe budget plus one, replacing stone_root with concrete costs exactly that slack and still passes. This contradicts the career rule of necessary-minimum protection and lets an over-armored design receive approval.
medium: Selective ruby is inconsistent across screens: 稚魚 appears without ruby at its first visible use, and the non-perfect bank preview displays 瀬・淵 without ruby on that screen.
Several choice-button labels exceed the binding 2–6-character target, including 「まだ回復していない」「石積み＋根固め」「魚道をつける」.
low: The water-trace terminal failure text explicitly states the comparison method after failure; acceptable as terminal remediation, but more explanatory than the otherwise world-first feedback.

recommended_actions: In bankValidate, reject concrete for every non-severe section when stone_root is sufficient; alternatively remove the slack or score/enforce the unique minimum safe plan before approval.
Ensure the approved bank result text reflects the actual plan rather than asserting necessary-minimum design unconditionally.
Add first-use ruby for 稚魚 and for 瀬・淵 in every result-screen branch where they appear.
Shorten long choice labels while retaining explanatory text in their subtitles.
